question:
What approximate value will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?

49.85 – 5.31 + 9.97 = ?
solution:
BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2042326d26ec7b593e52bbbdd22d890b59b1e59f92be81a7235509e9af1c4625.png] 

According to the given question:

Given equation : 49.85 – 5.31 + 9.97 = ?

To simplify, we perform the operations in order:

&rArr
; 49.85 – 5.31 = 44.54

⇒ 44.54 + 9.97 = 54.51

Rounding 54.51 to the nearest whole number:

**⇒ 54.51 ≈ 55**

Hence, the correct answer is *'Option 4'.*
